content.text: Stripe, PayPal, and other conventional payment processors have restricted access for digital creators in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and more. This has left many without a reliable way to sell digital products, forcing them to operate in the shadows or abandon their online businesses altogether. That's why owning a sovereign commerce infrastructure is crucial, and COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack offers a solution that puts creators back in control.
What Each Option Actually Offers

The Edge Commerce Stack provides a comprehensive solution for digital creators, including a storefront built on Cloudflare Pages, backend logic powered by Cloudflare Workers, order storage with Supabase, and automatic on-chain crypto payment verification through NOWPayments. This stack offers a seamless and secure way to sell digital products, without relying on restricted payment processors. In contrast, renting a platform like Stripe or PayPal leaves creators vulnerable to account freezes and fund withholding, highlighting the importance of ownership and control in commerce infrastructure.

COREMERCH's Edge Commerce Stack is specifically designed for creators operating in restricted countries, providing a reliable and secure way to process payments without relying on conventional payment processors. This stack is built on cloud infrastructure, allowing creators to deploy and manage their storefronts independently, without being tied to a specific country or region. In contrast, platforms like Stripe and PayPal are often subject to country-specific restrictions, leaving creators without a viable way to earn income.

For digital creators operating in restricted countries, the Edge Commerce Stack is the obvious choice. This stack provides a reliable, secure, and scalable way to process payments and manage commerce operations, without relying on conventional payment processors. By choosing the Edge Commerce Stack, creators can take back control of their business and build a sustainable income stream, free from the risks associated with renting a platform.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

Sovereign infrastructure means the creator owns every component of their commerce operation — not as a policy promise, but as a technical reality. The storefront code is in your GitHub or Cloudflare account. The customer email list is in your Supabase database or Google Sheet. The order and payment history is exportable as CSV at any time from your own database. The product files are in your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The NOWPayments account is registered under your email address. The wallet addresses and all funds inside them were never touched by COREMERCH. The domain and DNS are under your registrar account. COREMERCH has no access after delivery — not as a limitation on our end, but because the infrastructure was deployed under your accounts from the first commit. If COREMERCH ceased to exist tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is the technical definition of sovereignty applied to commerce infrastructure.
By choosing the Edge Commerce Stack, creators can avoid payment platform suspension and account freezes.

Your Deployment Checklist

Move any existing revenue out of platform custodial accounts and into a self-custody wallet you control — Trust Wallet for mobile, MetaMask for browser, hardware wallet for larger amounts. Create a NOWPayments account and configure it with your self-custody wallet addresses — funds route directly to your wallet on every transaction with no platform holding period. Deploy your sovereign stack under your own accounts — GitHub or Cloudflare, your choice of database, your NOWPayments API key, your delivery email service. Confirm that your order database gives you an independent transaction record — Supabase or Google Sheets — that does not depend on any platform's continued operation. Complete a mainnet test transaction and verify the complete pipeline before promoting. Set up a P2P exchange account for currency conversion. Review your stack configuration once per month — confirm wallet addresses are current in NOWPayments, backend endpoint is live, and delivery emails are reaching inboxes rather than spam.
